meta.author: Dolman
meta.purpose: Who actually owns each brand. The 'natural' shelf is largely owned by the same companies as the conventional shelf, and no product label says so. This field records the parent and the evidence level behind the claim.
meta.rule: An ownership claim is an evidence claim like any other. Nothing is recorded as verified without a resolvable primary source. Where two sources disagree, the disagreement is recorded, not resolved by preference.

known_conflict.subject: Method
known_conflict.claim_a: Unilever acquired Method in 2012 via its merger with Ecover.
known_conflict.claim_b: SC Johnson agreed in September 2017 to buy Method and Ecover from People Against Dirty, completing in 2018 after clearing regulators in the US, UK and Germany.
known_conflict.corroboration: UK Competition and Markets Authority final decision on the SC Johnson / People Against Dirty acquisition, which names Ecover and Method as PAD's brands and SC Johnson as the acquirer: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5a68b48340f0b63b5bc90fef/SCJ-PAD-final-decision.pdf
known_conflict.resolution: Contradicted by primary sources. Two independent sources, one of them a regulator's published merger decision, support claim B. Verified by Linnea, CCI-009 rev1: claim A is current, not stale, and remains wrong.
known_conflict.status: verified by Linnea, CCI-009 rev1 and CCI-67b9fae rev2

SC Johnson.detail: Privately held by the Johnson family for five generations since 1886, Racine, Wisconsin. Does not publish financial statements.

Unilever.detail: Acquired Seventh Generation in 2016, reported at approximately $700 million.

Reckitt.detail: Trades as Reckitt Benckiser in some markets. Both names appear as brand values in products.json, which is itself a data-quality issue.

Henkel.detail: German. Both 'Henkel' and 'Persil' appear as brand values in products.json.

Clorox.detail: Owns Burt's Bees as its natural-products arm.

Country Life LLC.detail: Aura Cacia moved from Frontier Co-op to Country Life LLC in July 2026 (BusinessWire, 6 July 2026). Verified by Linnea.

The Honest Company.detail: Public, Nasdaq: HNST, listed May 2021. Verified against SEC EDGAR.

Grove Collaborative.detail: Public, NYSE: GROV, listed June 2022. Verified against SEC EDGAR.

Costco Wholesale Corporation.detail: Owns and distributes the Kirkland Signature house brand, sold only on Costco shelves.

WinCo Foods, LLC.detail: Western-US grocery chain. Its All Purpose Cleaner with Bleach is distributed by WinCo and manufactured by KIK International.

Delta Brands & Products LLC.detail: Owns the PowerHouse value brand. The brand is sold through the Walgreens value shelf and other retailers; Walgreens is the channel, not the owner, which the value presentation is designed not to make obvious.

Greenbrier International.detail: Dollar Tree's product-development and import arm; the FDA labeler of record for Assured-brand products.

Dollar General Corporation.detail: Owns the True Living house brand.

Dollar Tree, Inc..detail: Owns Family Dollar; the Homeline house brand sits under it.

commodity.detail: Commodity goods sold by the pound or out of a bulk bin, with no brand owner to hold accountable. Recorded as 'commodity', which is not a company and is not the same as an unexamined gap. Without this entry apply_owners() silently stamped the two commodity products added on 2026-09-23 back to untested on the next build; the field was reverting.

independents.note: Brands with no parent company found. Recorded as 'no parent found', which is NOT the same as 'independently owned' and must never render as such. Absence of a finding is not a finding.
